query: ("Andhra Pradesh" OR Amaravati OR Visakhapatnam) AND ("AI" OR "artificial intelligence")

items.title: AI to create jobs; Amaravati to fund itself through land monetisation: Naidu
items.description: Naidu says AI will create new jobs; India can match China in 20 years. He backs Amaravati land monetisation, a quantum hub, and revised population policy.

items.title: Agnikul to set up an industrial unit in AP’s space city
items.description: Agnikul to set up Rs 500 crore industrial unit in Andhra Pradesh space city to support equatorial launches from Sriharikota and develop an orbital AI data centre.

items.title: Agnikul to set up Andhra Pradesh facility for orbital data centre units
items.description: Agnikul Cosmos will invest ₹510 crore in an Andhra Pradesh facility to build orbital data centre units, aiming to integrate AI computing hardware with its rocket upper stages

items.title: ReNew, CleanMax announce investments totalling ₹1.3 trillion into data centres, green energy space in Andhra Pradesh
items.description: ReNew commits  ₹80,000 crore for a green data centre and solar component plants, while CleanMax plans  ₹50,000 crore in clean energy to power an AI compute hub.

items.title: CleanMax to invest ₹50,000 crore in Andhra Pradesh to set up integrated clean energy complex
items.description: The proposed complex will power a dedicated 2 GW Green Compute Factory in Kurnool, in collaboration with Blackstone-backed AI cloud provider Neysa

items.title: CleanMax signs ₹50,000 crore MoU with Andhra Pradesh for green energy hub
items.description: The company plans to develop 3 GW of clean energy generation facilities, including wind, solar and pumped hydro projects, to supply round-the-clock power to an AI compute factory in Kurnool

items.title: Want to make Vizag AI data centre hub, says Andhra CM N Chandrababu Naidu
items.description: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu targets a $2.07 trillion state economy by 2047, with plans to position Visakhapatnam as an AI data centre hub and Tirupati as a global design capital.

items.title: Amaravati to host NIELIT’s ‘Quantum and AI University Campus’
items.description: Amaravati to host India’s first Quantum and AI University campus with NVIDIA-led AI Living Labs initiative and MeitY funding.

items.title: City-based CureBay raises Rs 100cr to expand rural healthcare network
items.description: CureBay raises nearly Rs 100 crore pre-Series C to expand rural healthcare network, add AI-led clinical services, and enter new markets like Andhra Pradesh.

items.title: Govt directs 80,000 school teachers to complete AI course by month end
items.description: Andhra Pradesh orders 80,000 govt school teachers (Classes VI–VIII) to finish an AI foundations online course via LEAP by Oct-end, with assessments and certificates.
